## Local AI fallback and error reports

- Review drawing pages individually with Ollama when the primary AI provider fails, reducing vision-context pressure while preserving page references.
- Increase Ollama's context window and flag page-level reviews for verification against the complete drawing set.
- Save new debug reports in an `error` folder beside the jobs folder. Previous reports remain in the jobs folder's `diagnostics` directory.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.33...v0.1.34
